context.goal: Keep Sloar reliable for long chat-based repository work while making web-design assistance adaptive to ambiguity, usable without design jargon, and resistant to unchosen generic AI-looking UI defaults.
completed: Published Sloar 0.8.0 to main at 527af933c975c94452cca53a98aa8ec8ac0b63c1 with tree 2ed9bffd2345b80ee8caeb95d23bd87430c4ef7d.

Added Adaptive Design Discovery with KNOWN/INFERRED/UNKNOWN ambiguity mapping, decision-value-based question selection, variable question budgets, ordinary-language prompts, 2-3 candidate directions when useful, and explicit handling of user delegation such as '알아서'.

Added a multi-axis Design DNA taxonomy separating philosophy/tone, material, composition, interaction, motion, density, typography and color; includes minimalism, maximalism, editorial, brutalism, neumorphism, glassmorphism, tactile/direct manipulation, context-aware interaction, spring/physics/morphing motion and related families without encouraging style soup.

Added Anti-AI-Slop guidance that is explicitly not an authorship detector. It classifies common unchosen generated/default UI tells across palette/material, typography, layout/IA, component styling, interaction/state, motion, copy/product evidence, imagery/fake data and second-order defaults.
Added P0/P1/P2 severity and CODE-CERTAIN/RENDER-CERTAIN/INFERRED evidence confidence so code heuristics cannot masquerade as rendered visual proof.

Added remedies that correct product direction and system coherence instead of mechanically swapping colors/fonts/radii, plus a second-order-default check so anti-slop itself does not become another universal style template.

Improved upgrade safety: exact untouched official web-design-guidance 0.7.0 bundles are fingerprint-verified, backed up under Git metadata and migrated to 0.8.0; modified/custom/unrecognized companions are preserved.
Updated English/Korean README, changelog, wizard, core skill, design companion, installer and CI for 0.8.0.
PR #13 passed Validate Sloar run #271 on the exact release head. Main push run #272 also completed successfully. PR #13 is merged/closed.

decisions: Users do not need design terminology; ordinary experiential language should be translated into internal multi-axis design reasoning.
Question count is adaptive. Ask only high-value questions that materially affect expensive/reversible design decisions; do not use a fixed questionnaire or serial interview loop.
When the user delegates with '알아서' / 'you decide', stop optional clarification and choose from product/repository evidence.
AI-looking visual patterns are not proof of AI authorship and are not global bans. The audit targets unchosen defaults and requires product/context justification.
Rendered visual evidence remains required for rendered visual claims when available; code/heuristic checks alone cannot prove balanced hierarchy or non-generic design.
Anti-slop must not become a second universal rescue aesthetic; product fit and coherent Design DNA remain the reason for choices.
A bundled companion may auto-migrate only when its exact installed fingerprint matches a known official historical bundle; version number alone is insufficient permission to overwrite.
Repository durable state always outranks chat memory and checkpoints.
